message.content:
I don’t know how many drones each customer has. That’s their business, not mine. I only track the airspace—like the corridors and sites—and how many of those are busy or closed. If a customer wants to know how many drones they’re running, they’d have to ask their own systems.

Sometimes a customer will tell me how many drones they’ve got at a site, but only so I can warn them if too many are trying to take off or land at once. That’s about capacity, not counting their entire fleet.
